item.title: Chess Platform & AI Coach: Real-Time WebRTC Chess Game
item.description:
GitHub (Chess Platform) · GitHub (AI Coach)

A modern full-stack real-time multiplayer chess platform enabling players worldwide to compete live while streaming video and audio directly in the browser over peer-to-peer connections. The platform also integrates an interactive AI chess coaching companion (chess.py) for move analysis, blunder detection, and positional evaluation.

Real-Time Architecture 

flowchart TD
PlayerA[Player 1: White] <-->|WebRTC P2P Video / Audio Stream via PeerJS| PlayerB[Player 2: Black]
PlayerA <-->|Socket.io WebSocket: Moves, Clocks & Chat| Server[Node.js / Express Server]
PlayerB <-->|Socket.io WebSocket: Moves, Clocks & Chat| Server
Server <--> Mongo[(MongoDB: User Profiles, ELO & Game History)]
subgraph Coach [AI Chess Coach Engine - chess.py]
BoardState[FEN / PGN Board State] --> Engine[Stockfish / Python Chess Analysis]
Engine --> Evaluation[Win Probability & Best Moves]
Evaluation --> Explanation[LLM Natural Language Advice]
end
Server -.-> Coach

Key Features

  1. Low-Latency Move Synchronization:

    • WebSocket bidirectionality using Socket.io guarantees sub-50ms move propagation, clock updates, and spectator broadcasting.
    • Comprehensive move validation, check/checkmate detection, and threefold repetition enforcement.

  2. Integrated Peer-to-Peer Video & Audio:

    • Direct WebRTC media tracks established via PeerJS allow players to see and speak to opponents live without routing high-bandwidth video streams through central servers.

  3. In-Game Chat & Chess Community:

    • In-game real-time messaging, player ELO rankings, interactive chess puzzles, and community article publishing.

  4. AI Chess Coach (chess.py):

    • Analyzes game positions in real time to explain tactical motifs (pins, forks, skewers, discovered checks) in plain English.

Tech Stack

  • Frontend: HTML5, Modern CSS / Bootstrap, Chessboard.js, PeerJS Client
  • Backend: Node.js, Express.js, Socket.io
  • Real-Time Media: WebRTC, PeerJS Server
  • Database: MongoDB & Mongoose
  • AI Coach: Python, python-chess, Stockfish Engine, LLM evaluations

Running the Platform Locally 

# Clone the web platform repository
git clone https://github.com/nagarajpoojari404/chessProject.git
cd chessProject

# Install dependencies
npm install

# Start the Node.js / Socket.io server
npm start
# Server listens on http://localhost:8000

item.title: DevPage: Social Platform & Collaborative Hub for Developers
item.description:
View on GitHub · Architecture · Tech Stack

DevPage is a dedicated social collaboration and portfolio showcase platform built specifically for software engineers—conceptualized as “Instagram for Developers”. Rather than generic images and status updates, DevPage centers around syntax-highlighted code snippets, engineering problem breakdowns, architectural post feeds, and developer showcase profiles.

Full-Stack Architecture 

flowchart TD
Client[Browser / DevPage Frontend] --> Gateway[Express.js Web Server]
subgraph Auth [Authentication & Identity]
Gateway <--> Cognito[AWS Cognito User Pools]
Gateway <--> GitHubAuth[GitHub OAuth 2.0 via Passport.js]
end
subgraph DataLayer [Storage & Media]
Gateway <--> Mongo[(MongoDB Atlas / Mongoose Models)]
Gateway <--> S3[(AWS S3: Developer Assets & Code Snippets)]
end
Gateway --> Renderer[EJS-Mate SSR Engine / Interactive Views]
Renderer --> Client

Key Capabilities

  1. Rich Code & Media Sharing:

    • Create technical posts embedding syntax-highlighted code blocks across 50+ programming languages.
    • Attach system architecture diagrams and flowcharts directly to technical write-ups.

  2. Dual Authentication & Security:

    • Integrated with GitHub OAuth 2.0 for one-click developer signup and automatic repository linking.
    • Enterprise-grade user pool management via AWS Cognito.

  3. Developer Profile & Portfolio:

    • Customizable profile showcasing GitHub statistics, featured repositories, technical skill tags, and published articles.

  4. Community Engagement:

    • Real-time comment threads on code snippets, upvoting, tag filtering, and technical bookmarking.

Tech Stack

Layer Technology
Backend Framework Node.js, Express.js
Authentication AWS Cognito, Passport.js (passport-github2), Express-Session
Database MongoDB Atlas, Mongoose ODM
Cloud Storage AWS S3 / AWS SDK
Templating / UI EJS-Mate, Bootstrap 5, Prism.js (Syntax Highlighting)

Running Locally 

# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/nagarajpoojari404/DevPage.git
cd DevPage

# Install dependencies
npm install

# Configure environment variables (.env)
cp .env.example .env
# Set DB_URL, GITHUB_CLIENT_ID, GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY

# Start development server with Nodemon
npm start
